text:
Maya: Quick sync: EdgeWorks wants to know our policy for device replay windows and whether we accept partner hourly rollups as source of truth for reconciliation. Can we decide?

Ibrahim: TL;DR: accept replays, dedupe by (batch_id OR seq_num). Default grace_window = 72h for automatic non-billing adjustments. Partner overrides up to 7d require legal + billing signoff.

Jo: On rollups: we will ingest partner hourly rollups for reconciliation only. Ledger remains source of record for billing, but rollups can trigger alerts if delta > threshold. EdgeWorks can submit signed rollups (manifest + sig) and we compare them in nightly job.

edgeworks-api: We will provide both individual events and hourly rollups. Rollups format sample: {hour: "2026-03-20T10:00:00Z", compute_hours: 12.5, batch_id: "r-20260320-10"}. We'll include HMAC header.

Ibrahim: Reconciliation rules (draft): write ledger rows with partner_id, hashed_device_id, usage_unit, source_batch_id, seq_num, original_ts, ingest_ts, dedupe_key. Daily aggregator compares ledger vs partner rollup per partner/sku/hour. Create alert if abs(delta) > max(0.5% * partner_total, 10 units).

FinanceBot: Note: adjustments created by replay overrides should be marked adjustment_pending and surfaced in nightly adjustments report. Create FIN ticket if adjustment_pending persists >48h.

Jo: API responses: 202 Accepted (include batch_id + received_count), 400 bad json, 401 invalid signature, 409 batch already processed (return existing_ingest_ts), 422 missing replay id when replay flagged.

Ibrahim: Operational limits: partner rate limit 150 req/s, max payload 1MB or 5k readings before pagination. Backfill TTL default 72h. Backfill longer than default requires partner opt-in.

Maya: Action items: Ibrahim to publish dedupe helper + docs (ETA 3d), Jo to wire rollup comparator + alerts (ETA 5d), Finance to add adjustments queue and FIN ticket automation (ETA 4d), EdgeWorks to send public key and confirm rollup manifest schema (ETA 2d).

edgeworks-api: Confirmed. We'll upload public key and start sending signed rollups tomorrow.

Maya: Great. We'll pick this up in the partner onboarding call Friday. Thanks all!
